comment: Nightly Boat measurements of main, run by run_probes.py on default Boat VMs, one per snapshot (`snapshot`, else the top-level default). A probe whose `requires` paths are absent at the commit is skipped, so a lane registers its probe here in the PR that adds the benchmark. `prepare` is untimed (builds); `run` is timed when `timed` names a metric, and any line it prints as `METRIC {json}` is recorded too (metric, value, unit, statistic, optional workload, samples, caveats).

probes.name: sim-dst-serial
probes.prepare: cargo nextest run --locked -p norn-cell -p norn-cell-do --profile ci --no-run
probes.run: cargo nextest run --locked -p norn-cell -p norn-cell-do --profile ci --test-threads 1 -E 'test(/injected|mutant_do|mutant_comm|do_transaction_glue|do_request/)'
probes.caveats: The 11-test DST simulator set (steps 1 and 1b, #1248), serial, nextest Summary wall time; one default Boat VM, single run. Simulator stores are unsynced on /dev/shm by design; before that change file-store reopen cost varied about 5x between VMs. Step 2 responder tests are excluded so this id stays comparable.

probes.name: promoted-proof-gates
probes.prepare: mkdir -p target && ln -sfn ~/norn/target/verification-tools target/verification-tools && ln -sfn ~/norn/target/ontology-tools target/ontology-tools && export CI=true && python3 -m venv /tmp/probe-venv && /tmp/probe-venv/bin/pip install --quiet --disable-pip-version-check jsonschema==4.25.1 PyYAML==6.0.3 && export PATH=/tmp/probe-venv/bin:$PATH && scripts/bootstrap-verification-tools.sh && scripts/bootstrap-ontology-tools.sh && scripts/bootstrap-rust-extraction-tools.sh
probes.caveats: Wall time of the formal phase's proof run (verify-promoted-subsystems.sh full), on the verification-tools snapshot whose prebuilt tool roots are linked in; the bootstraps (checksum checks) are untimed. Per-gate values are the script's own [pass] seconds (1 s resolution). One run on a default Boat VM; Rust builds inside the gate start cold.

probes.name: studio-bundle-size
probes.caveats: Production vite build of apps/studio without prebuilding the Rust WASM checker/engine packages (apps/studio/src/checker, apps/studio/src/engine). `studio.bundle.initial_*` sums only the local entry script/modulepreload/stylesheet assets referenced by dist/index.html; `studio.bundle.js.*`, `studio.bundle.css.*`, and `studio.bundle.total_dist_bytes` cover all emitted files under dist/ (including lazy chunks and dist/widgets from closeBundle). Gzip sizes use deterministic Python gzip level 9 (mtime=0).

probes.name: binary-and-wasm-sizes
probes.prepare: TARGET_DIR="${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$PWD/target}"; case "$TARGET_DIR" in /*) ;; *) TARGET_DIR="$PWD/$TARGET_DIR" ;; esac; export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET_DIR"; rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo build --locked --release -p norn-cli --bin norn && (cd crates/norn-cell-rivet && CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET_DIR/rivet" cargo build --locked --release --bin norn-cell-rivet) && cargo rustc --locked -p norn-checker-wasm --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm-release --crate-type cdylib && cargo build --locked -p norn-cell-do --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm-release
probes.run: TARGET_DIR="${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$PWD/target}"; case "$TARGET_DIR" in /*) ;; *) TARGET_DIR="$PWD/$TARGET_DIR" ;; esac; python3 scripts/metrics/probe_binary_sizes.py --target-dir "$TARGET_DIR" --rivet-target-dir "$TARGET_DIR/rivet"
probes.caveats: Unstripped release native binaries (Linux x86_64 ELF) and wasm-release cdylib .wasm artifacts before wasm-bindgen/wasm-opt; gzip sizes use deterministic Python gzip level 9 (mtime=0).

probes.name: engine-core-metrics
probes.caveats: Single-thread deterministic release micro-benchmark on one Boat VM (native bundled SQLite in JournalMode::Delete, in-memory cells for VmRSS delta, storage/cell CellHost::load reads without caller-level Cedar PDP authz, standalone JDM decision and ZEN expression loops); each metric is one timed/measured batch (samples=1) with operation counts in workload.
